verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right banner flow (brand/product, then headline, copy, CTA), but the subcopy wraps to leave 'hour.' orphaned on its own line, and the 'NEW FLAVOR' badge is oversized and competes with the tiny SOLSTICE logo stacked under it. The CTA is also a bit heavy. B squeezes the subcopy into a narrow five-line column jammed between the can and the CTA, which is awkward and ragged. Its huge badge competes with the headline, and the headline crowds the decorative circle at the top-right edge.
